questions.question: A patient is examined for vestibular function. Which structure detects angular acceleration?
A hair cell is stimulated by bending its stereocilia. Which direction causes depolarization?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Toward the kinocilium

questions.question: A person is rotating at a constant speed. What happens to the sensation of rotation after some time?
A person suddenly stops rotating. Which sensation is expected?
options: Complete loss of balance without vertigo

questions.question: After rotation stops, persistent endolymph movement produces which clinical effect?
Regarding utricle, what is its function?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D. Detection of backward head tilt

questions.question: How can the brain detect that your head is upright?
options: Impulses increase from macula of utricle and decrease from macula of saccule
Impulses decrease from macula of utricle and increase from macula of saccule
Impulses discharge is minimal and equal tonic from the maculae of both sides
Impulses decrease from lateral semicircular canals on both sides
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. Impulses discharge is minimal and equal tonic from the maculae of both sides

questions.question: During forward horizontal acceleration, what are the changes that occur in impulses discharged from vestibular apparatus?
options: The otoliths move forward leading to bending of the cilia and a sensation of falling backwards
The otoliths move backwards leading to bending of the cilia and a sensation of falling forwards
The otoliths move forwards leading to bending of the cilia and a sensation of falling forwards
The otoliths move backwards leading to bending of the cilia and a sensation of falling backwards
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D. The otoliths move backwards leading to bending of the cilia and a sensation of falling backwards

questions.question: What does jerky to & fro movement of the eyes refer to?
Regarding the hair cell in the cristae, what is their structure?
options: Many small kinocilia and one large stiff stereocilium
Many small stereocilia and one large stiff kinocilium
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Many small stereocilia and one large stiff kinocilium
